_mode_a_simple: Set offMarketVolumeLast12Months to a single dollar number. Pipeline distributes proportionally to per-town MLSPIN slice. Easy but towns where Bentley has 0 MLSPIN sales (e.g. Rowley currently) stay 0.
_mode_b_precise: Set yourTownVolumeOverride with per-town totals (incl off-market). Pipeline uses these directly and ignores offMarketVolumeLast12Months. This is how to reproduce the existing page exactly.
_comment_about_firm_name: How RE/MAX Bentley's appears in the chart. Pipeline matches any office name containing the keywords below (case-insensitive).
_comment_about_brands: Competitor brands. Pipeline groups every office name containing the keywords below into the canonical display name. Order doesn't matter; first-match wins per record.
_comment_about_constants: Things MLSPIN can't tell us — keep these in sync manually.
